sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Repair the prescriptive SPARQL while preserving the already-correct direct-calculation bypass and attached, non-mandatory spacing shape. The scope branches are inverted: NOT EXISTS for each region allows missing required regions and therefore causes accidental passes. Use positive EXISTS constraints: for span > 4 require bow, midbody, stern, and otherIceStrengthenedAreaValue; for span <= 4 with IA Super require all four; with IA require bow and midbody; with IB or IC require bow. Also make spacing applicability an independent OR: if frameAsymmetrical is true OR frameWebAngleToShell is below 90, enforce spacing <= 1300 without requiring the other selector input.
